property_summary: Only addresses marked admin can successfully call newEmergencyOracle (i.e., calling newEmergencyOracle reverts for non-admins).
Only callers with isAdmin[msg.sender]==true can successfully call newEmergencyOracle (i.e., newEmergencyOracle reverts iff the caller is not an admin).
Calls to newEmergencyOracle revert exactly when the caller is not an admin (isAdmin[msg.sender] == false).
The call to c.newEmergencyOracle must revert exactly when this contract is not the admin (i.e., callerCandidate == address(this) iff the call does not revert).

For any admin caller that creates a new EmergencyOracle via newEmergencyOracle, the oracle's owner should equal the caller (msg.sender); the mutant that passes address(this) as owner causes the created oracle's owner to differ from the caller for those callers that are not the C contract itself (i.e., any EOA admin).
